record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PSYSTRIKE: Mewtwo and Shadow Mewtwo (both 3 stars, maxPP 110, range 3, no passive). The strategy is shared; both listed units are identical in stars, so they share the same raw damage. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Needs a target (inherited requiresTarget = true). The line end is the farthest targettable unit on the board by Manhattan distance (board scan row by row, the first at the maximum wins), or the cast target when none is found. Every enemy-team entity on the supercover line from the caster's cell to that unit (both endpoints) is collected; if none, the farthest unit is added. Each collected enemy takes requested SPECIAL damage 80 (both listed units are 3 stars; table 20 / 40 / 80 / 160, 160 fallback) through handleSpecialDamage with the cast's crit flag (crit needs ABILITY_CRIT), and right after its own damage call the enemy is moved by forced displacement to the free cell, among the cells on the lines from its position to the two back corners of its own team's side, that is farthest by Chebyshev distance (no move if no such cell, or if the enemy is skydiving, locked or holds Heavy Duty Boots). The teleport happens whether or not the damage was blocked.

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity on the line cells between the caster and the farthest targettable unit; the farthest unit (or the cast target) as fallback
targeting.note: The line end does not come from the cast target but from getFarthestTarget (Manhattan distance, strictly greater, scan order); the cast target is used only when that returns undefined. The caster's own cell is on the line but filtered out as same-team; allies are skipped.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's cell to the farthest targettable unit's cell, endpoints included; teleport destinations lie on the supercover lines from each hit enemy to its team's two back-row corners

effects.target: each collected enemy (once per enemy, set semantics)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] ?? 160. handleSpecialDamage multiplies by (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true), x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE, x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT, and on a crit by 1 + (critPower - 1) x the target's crit reduction factor (Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite). Crit needs ABILITY_CRIT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers, handed to PokemonState.handleDamage: divided by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef of the target), rounded up with a minimum of 1, absorbed first by the target's shield. takenDamage (not stored by this strategy) = shield damage + HP damage capped at current HP; 0 for a protected / skydiving / Magic Bounce target. Requested, applied and takenDamage are three different amounts.

effects.target: each collected enemy, after that enemy's damage call

declaredRaw.description: forced moveTo of the enemy to getTeleportationCell(enemy position, enemy team)

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: getTeleportationCell collects the free cells on the supercover lines from the enemy's current cell to its team's two back-row corners, sorts by Chebyshev distance from the enemy (greatest first, ties in collection order) and returns the first; undefined when no free cell exists. moveTo(…, true) returns without moving when the enemy cannot be moved (skydiving, locked, Heavy Duty Boots); otherwise the unit goes to its moving state, the cells are swapped and its cooldown is set to 100. Enemies are processed in insertion (line) order, so earlier teleports change which cells are free for later ones, and the enemy's position is read after its own damage.

starBehavior.note: Only the damage depends on stars (index stars-1 of the casting entity). 20 / 40 / 160 are not reached by the listed units at their factory star counts. Whether other mechanics change a unit's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Line end: board scan order y outer, x inner with strictly greater Manhattan distance, so ties go to the first scanned. Teleport: depends on the enemy's team (which two corners) and on free cells along those lines; if none is free the enemy stays.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast recomputes the line and the teleports.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 80 for both listed units. Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) x DOUBLE_DAMAGE x steam x crit factor; applied after speDef, minimum 1 and shield; takenDamage = shield + HP part. The teleport is not a numeric amount: it is requested for every collected enemy and applied only if a free cell exists and the enemy can be moved.
